docs.abstract: FusionServer G5500 V7 (G5500 V7) is a new-generation 4U 2-socket GPU server. G5500 V7 accelerates applications such as AI training, AI inference, high-performance computing (HPC), image and video analysis, and database, and supports enterprise and public cloud deployment.
